name: verifier-progress
goal: Diagnose hosted snapshot timeout with phase and check progress and retain partial logs without relaxing verification gates

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Head 5708df3f hosted verifier cancelled at 180 minutes with no record or artifacts; full check passed. Reconstructed plan has 1067 serial checks after uncertainty expansion.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing verify.e2e baseline only asserts final record; ci-native-verify only checks normal artifact configuration. Extend these standardized tests for opt-in stderr phases and timeout artifact lifecycle.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test and shared coverage; run it failing before repair and record the command, assertion and result.
steps.evidence: nice -n 15 bun x vitest run test/verify.e2e.test.ts test/ci-native-verify.test.ts -t fixture-baseline-or-macOS-obligations --maxWorkers 1 --minWorkers 1: two assertion failures, no history progress and missing timeout/upload-always. /tmp/harness-verifier-progress-red.log; 9.53 seconds.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opt-in structured stderr marks history, trusted base, index, impact, snapshot, tools, individual checks, drift and record assembly. CI reserves ten minutes for cleanup/upload and always retains partial outputs; verification gates and job limit unchanged.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same strengthened tests pass unchanged. Final low-priority single-worker run of verify.e2e, ci-native-verify, cli-environment.e2e and verify-snapshot.e2e: 16 passed in 69.02 seconds. JSON stdout, silent defaults, full source-mutation guards retained. /tmp/harness-verifier-progress-final-focused.log

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
